in_marathi.name: Haru
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of rain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Haru हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Haru is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Hari, who is often referred to as the god of rain. In Hindu mythology, Hari is a manifestation of Vishnu, and is also known as Vishnu's alter ego, Krishna. The name Haru carries the power and energy of the monsoon season and the renewal of life that comes with it.
